iteration_gate: Do not claim an evidence-driven iteration until verified session evidence points to a named decision. A changed UI is an iteration, not a validated improvement.
retest_gate: After a named decision changes, freeze the changed build and rerun the affected task with new or explicitly marked returning participants before claiming improvement.
next_valid_transition: Recruit an eligible participant, obtain consent, record an anonymized session, append atomic evidence, then synthesize without promoting proxy evidence or invented metrics.
